description: Outlook for Energy Report is a dataset listed in KAPSARC Data Portal, an energy economics open data portal, published or maintained by King Abdullah Petroleum Studies and Research Center (KAPSARC). The Outlook for Energy is ExxonMobil’s long-term global view of energy demand and supply. Its findings help to guide ExxonMobil's long-term investments, Outlook help to promote a better understanding of the issues shaping the world’s energy future. Updated each year, this dataset covers the period to 2040. Coverage: as titled: Saudi Arabia, the Gulf states, India or the world (see the dataset page). The portal files it under Conventional Fuels. The portal shows 2022-07-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Public Domain. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy, water and transport system studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kapsarc-open-data-portal.
